name: Enthalpy v0.4.5
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.5

## Changed

- Lets a signed-in device connect to a synced workspace with its workspace passphrase and an empty local folder. Device approval codes are no longer required.
- Keeps first Sync setup in one Go operation and shows one clear busy state while setup runs.
- Transfers workspace files as exact bytes when Enthalpy metadata is invalid. Unsafe paths, linked entries, unreadable files, and changing files still stop Sync.
- Uses one matched Wails runtime version in the application, generated bindings, and build tools.

## Fixed

- Keeps native folder handles open until operating-system file calls finish.
- Accepts a remote result when another device has already published the same
  local tree. This prevents a needless merge and an incorrect offline state.
- Keeps conflict packages complete across restart and removes the complete
  package after the user applies a resolution.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
